name: AADCO Medical, Inc.
old_description: As an Original Equipment Manufacturer, AADCO Medical expends significant resources on product development. Whether it be our newest innovative, original, and patented products, or subtle enhancements in the quality and usability of all-time customer favorites.
about:
AADCO Medical, Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Randolph, Vermont. The company operates its design, engineering, manufacturing, and distribution facilities from Catamount Commercial Park in Randolph.

As an original equipment manufacturer, AADCO develops and produces medical imaging equipment and radiology protection products. Its product line includes the ErgoLite® radiation protection apron, Hercules® and MRI-Safe® overhead suspension systems, mobile barriers, mobile lighting, lead gloves, and protective eyewear. All products are manufactured at the company's Vermont facility.

The company serves hospitals, radiology labs, and interventional radiologists across the United States and internationally through its affiliate AADCO Medical, Asia-Pacific, Ltd. in Hong Kong. Customers include professionals such as Dr. Douglas Coldwell, an interventional radiologist who has endorsed the ErgoLite® apron for reducing back strain during long procedures.

AADCO emphasizes a quality management system certified to ISO 13485:2016, along with UL, CE, and CB certifications. The company highlights its U.S.-based manufacturing, a dedicated team of long-term employees, and lean processes that it says allow faster, more affordable delivery than larger competitors. Warranties extend beyond industry standards, including a lifetime warranty on radiation protection aprons and a 10-year warranty on Hercules® suspension systems.
